Ok, so I fell in love with these movies when I was probably a bit too young to be watching them.

The first movie tried really hard to be scary, and for me at the time it absolutely was. The second was the perfect combination of humor and horror and in my opinion the best of the franchise. The third was a full blown comedy/horror epic that went way over the top in all the right ways, but was lacking a bit in the gore department.

When they announced the remake I was so disappointed and I refused to go see it out of spite. Eventually I did see it and I honestly fucking loved it. Everyone was talking about how shitty it was becuase it wasn't "funny" or whatever, but I feel like they really nailed the tone that the first movie was trying to have. Some of the most intense gore I can imagine in a mainstream movie as well. Also the TINNNNNNY post credits homage to the original films...which I'm not sure what it was meant to imply...but seemed to be that Ash was in fact still around and part of the series....

ALL that to say, what tone do you think the new show will have? It's featuring Ash post Army of Darkness, but just from the screenshots they've shown so far it already has more blood than Army of Darkness. Do you think that they'll end up somewhere in between? What exactly is between the old and the new...and the newest?
